title: Соус Лаврова и полтергейст  (Sauce Lavrov and the Poltergeist)

scenes.title: Фирменное блюдо и полтергейст  (A Signature Dish and a Poltergeist)
scenes.summary: Max decides to create a new signature dish to replace his humble pâté, and when the kitchen lights go out, the cooks suspect the ghost of Grandpa Kirill.

scenes.title: Новый директор Кристина  (The New Director Kristina)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev introduces Kristina Semyonovna as the new director of Claude Monet, stunning the entire staff while Chef Barinov picks up Katya from the hospital.

scenes.title: Бывший кабинет Вики  (Vika's Former Office)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev gives Kristina Vika's former office, and Kristina claims she wants to live on her own earnings while tricking Nagiyev into giving her cash right away.

scenes.title: Заговор Сени и Феди  (Senya and Fedya's Conspiracy)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya reveal they faked the poltergeist so they can blame stolen meat and workplace slacking on the ghost, and paint pig's blood on the mirror.

scenes.title: Самое дорогое блюдо Макса  (Max's Most Expensive Dish)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov returns with Katya, dismisses the poltergeist rumors, hates Max's expensive dish of caviar, truffles, and marbled beef, and bans Max from using costly ingredients.

scenes.title: Пароль от айпада и новая мебель  (The iPad Password and New Furniture)
scenes.summary: Kristina learns Nagiyev's iPad password is his birthday and convinces him not to cancel her expensive order for new restaurant furniture.

scenes.title: Записи с камер и сквозняк  (Camera Footage and a Draft)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov argues that ghosts do not exist and watches security footage of objects moving in the kitchen, blaming it on a draft.

scenes.title: История майонеза и идея соуса  (The Story of Mayonnaise and the Sauce Idea)
scenes.summary: Katya inspires Max with the story of how mayonnaise was invented from simple olive oil and eggs during a siege, and Max decides to invent a signature sauce.

scenes.title: Спонсор холодца — полтергейст  (The Meat Jelly's Sponsor Is the Poltergeist)
scenes.summary: Max names his new creation Sauce Lavrov for salmon, while Chef Barinov overhears Senya and Fedya boasting about stealing meat under the cover of the poltergeist.

scenes.title: Побочный эффект тимьяна  (The Side Effect of Thyme)
scenes.summary: Katya and Chef Barinov praise the taste of Max's new sauce until Barinov realizes that thyme decoction mixed with alcohol induces vomiting.

scenes.title: Идея с караоке и свиная голова  (The Karaoke Idea and a Pig's Head)
scenes.summary: Kristina talks Nagiyev into buying the second-floor apartment for cash to open a karaoke room, while Chef Barinov plants a pig's head in Senya's locker.

scenes.title: Ночная смена и игра в карты  (The Night Shift and a Card Game)
scenes.summary: Fedya swears Grandpa Kirill's ghost is real, and Nagiyev orders Chef Barinov and Katya to work a night shift for his high-stakes poker game.

scenes.title: Двойная оплата и химия Кати  (Double Pay and Katya's Chemistry)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov keeps Max, Katya, Senya, and Fedya for the night shift with promises of double pay, and Katya explains the chemistry of thyme oil to Max.

scenes.title: Как удалить злое вещество  (How to Remove the Bad Substance)
scenes.summary: Katya explains how chemistry can remove the nausea-inducing compound from thyme while keeping the taste, and Nagiyev plays cards with his wealthy guests.

scenes.title: Проверка соуса на Нагиеве  (Testing the Sauce on Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Max and Katya finish the modified sauce, Kristina excuses herself to the office to steal Nagiyev's money, and Max sends the test salmon dish to Nagiyev.

scenes.title: Нагиев хвалит сёмгу  (Nagiyev Praises the Salmon)
scenes.summary: Max tells Chef Barinov that Katya made the sauce safe for drinkers and they served it to Nagiyev, who loves it and orders portions for all the guests.

scenes.title: Яблочный сок вместо виски  (Apple Juice Instead of Whiskey)
scenes.summary: Katya invites Max over to celebrate their sauce, Kostya reveals Nagiyev has been secretly drinking apple juice instead of whiskey, and the real whiskey-drinking guests get sick.

scenes.title: Гнев Нагиева после покера  (Nagiyev's Wrath After Poker)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev storms into the kitchen furious that the guests got sick and he lost all his money, and Chef Barinov blames the kitchen's bad luck on a poltergeist.

scenes.title: Месть деда Кирилла  (Grandpa Kirill's Revenge)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya are terrified in the dark kitchen when Chef Barinov appears disguised as Grandpa Kirill's ghost to punish them for their pranks.

scenes.title: Письмо Кристины и просроченная рыба  (Kristina's Letter and the Expired Fish)
scenes.summary: Kristina leaves Nagiyev a letter after draining his accounts and leaving Russia, and Chef Barinov tells Max that the salmon was expired, not the sauce.
